hotels.title: HYATT CENTRIC REIMS LPP
hotels.description: Set in the heart of Reims, this contemporary stay places you moments from the city’s Champagne houses and the Gothic splendour of Notre-Dame de Reims. Place Drouet-d’Erlon is close by for cafés, brasseries and late-night drinks, while the Musée des Beaux-Arts and the covered Halles du Boulingrin offer a taste of local culture and produce. Inside, the hotel pairs clean-lined design with a rooftop terrace and a fitness room for easy downtime between outings. The restaurant serves seasonal dishes, and the bar pours Champagne from the surrounding region. Reims Champagne-Ardenne station is a short drive away, with the vineyards of the Montagne de Reims within easy reach
